How to stay calm when failing: Is this the first time you've failed? Is this the last time you will fail?

The first step to becoming a better gamer, and even the best if that's what you're aiming for is to stop getting angry. The moment you get angry, stop playing and go have a cold shower and cool off.

Understand that only with patience, practice and calm thinking will score you that win. Anger only applies to purely physical sports and even then, it doesn't actually work very well.

I play team games, the way in which I have improved is to play as if any loss is only my fault, what could I have changed to win? Then do that next time.

And accept that there will always be that one guy who's either better than you or uses the cheap tactic to get #1.
